strengths: Recognizable front silhouette and broadly correct head-to-shaft proportion.
Head is one connected authored cage rather than a pile of blade primitives.
Shaft, collar transitions and pommel are one connected 12-sided all-quad revolved cage.
A 3/4 render contradicted the first uniform-depth plate and triggered a tapered-depth correction.
Fresh Blender 5.2 verification reproduced the saved-file renders and technical state.
failures: The head still reads as one monolithic plate rather than two forged blade masses attached around a central socket.
The single front reference does not justify the inferred rear taper strongly enough.
Blade planes lack the target's layered ridges and directional facets.
Shaft collar spacing and pommel are simplified.
The two head cap n-gons are acceptable for this planar non-SubD blockout, but they are not an all-quad production head.
capability_claim: This is evidence of bounded connected-cage construction and adaptive correction, not proof of general reference-to-model competence.
